title: Accessibility and usable UI
problem: Automated scans cannot establish usable keyboard and assistive flows.
rationale: UI changes require applicable checks/review; no full accessibility certification from a scanner. Non-UI projects show N/A.
applicability: Changed user interfaces; non-UI projects require explicit N/A.
baseline_policy: No legacy waiver for required verification or release prerequisites.

target_check.deterministic: existing browser accessibility, keyboard/focus and responsive tests against the candidate, using project tools.
target_check.reviewer: task usability and unsupported assistive scenarios.
target_check.limits: **D:** existing browser accessibility, keyboard/focus and responsive tests against the candidate, using project tools. **R:** task usability and unsupported assistive scenarios.
target_check.configuration: Project-approved native configuration, immutable source/tool/config pins and applicable evidence mappings; UI changes require applicable checks/review; no full accessibility certification from a scanner. Non-UI projects show N/A.

expected_evidence: **D:** existing browser accessibility, keyboard/focus and responsive tests against the candidate, using project tools. **R:** task usability and unsupported assistive scenarios.
repair: Repair the affected keyboard/focus/responsive or accessibility path and rerun project browser tests plus usability review. Missing prerequisites remain Unsupported/Error.
